issues.title_en: New transmission from animals likely caused Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak, study says
issues.summary: DAKAR, Aug 11 - The ongoing Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo concerns a previously unseen variant of the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, indicating it stemmed from a new transmission from animals to humans rather than from variants linked to earlier outbreaks, a new study said. Read more at straitstimes.com.
